messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 15(3)

Article 15 Obligations of distributors of machinery and related products. 3. Where a distributor considers or has reason to believe that machinery or a related product is not in conformity with this Regulation, the distributor shall not make the machinery or related product available on the market until it has been brought into conformity. Furthermore, where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, to the environment, the distributor shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities to that effect.

response.text:
machinery or related product | shallNotBeMadeAvailable | on the market | distributor considers or has reason to believe it is not in conformity with this Regulation; lasts until it has been brought into conformity | the distributor shall not make the machinery or related product available on the market until it has been brought into conformity
distributor | shallInform | manufacturer or importer | machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons | the distributor shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities to that effect
distributor | shallInform | market surveillance authorities | machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons | the distributor shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities to that effect
machinery or related product | presentsRiskTo | domestic animals and property | risk to health and safety of persons and where appropriate | where appropriate, domestic animals and property
machinery or related product | presentsRiskTo | environment | where applicable | where applicable, to the environment
